SproutChance.Desc: Multiplies Grow Chance for mown lawn (no grass left). Lower keeps a mown lawn mown; 1 is no change.
AllGrassIsLawn.Desc: Treat all grass starter grass as lawn
ProtectNonLawn.Desc: Prevent destruction of non-lawn grass starter grass.
TrufflesInGrass.Desc: Allow pigs to dig up truffles in grass.
MatchMapGrass.Desc: Paint the lawn with the grass tile from the loaded outdoor tilesheet, so it matches vanilla or your recolour pack.
MapGrassTileIndex.Desc: Tile index in the outdoor tilesheet to take the grass from. 175 is the plain farm grass; 351 is the darker patch by the farmhouse.
